How a project runs

Six steps from the first conversation to handover.

  1. Initial consultation

    We agree your requirements, scope, timescale and expectations.

  2. Site survey

    We take measurements and check access and installation constraints.

  3. Planning and preparation

    Materials, labour and schedules are organised before work starts.

  4. Installation

    Our team carries out the agreed shopfitting and interior work.

  5. Quality control

    We check workmanship, finishes and installation details throughout.

  6. Final completion

    Final adjustments, snagging and finishing before handover.
